questions: Does the tremor also affect your left hand or arm?
Do you notice the tremor stops or improves when you are using that hand to do something, like reaching for a cup?
Have you noticed that your right arm or hand feels stiffer than the left?
Do you feel like your right side moves more slowly than your left when doing things like buttoning a shirt?
Have you noticed your handwriting becoming smaller or more cramped?
Have you or anyone else noticed you've been walking more stiffly or taking smaller steps?
Do you feel unsteady or more prone to falling?
Did these symptoms start on one side of your body first?
Have these symptoms been gradually getting worse over the past year?
Do you have a parent or sibling with a similar tremor or movement disorder?
Are you taking any medications like an antipsychotic, an anti-nausea drug, or a mood stabilizer?
Have you experienced any tremors when your hands are resting comfortably, other than what's in your right hand?
